description: This file contains functions for loading and reading skill files, parsing frontmatter, and managing skill directories within a project. It handles file system operations, skill metadata extraction, and safe file reading.

methods.name: isPathWithinRoot
methods.description: Checks if a given path is within the specified root directory.

methods.name: readSkillFileSync
methods.description: Reads a skill file synchronously if it is within the root directory and not a symlink.

methods.name: loadSingleSkillDirectory
methods.description: Loads a skill from a directory by reading its SKILL.md file and parsing frontmatter.

methods.name: listCandidateSkillDirs
methods.description: Lists subdirectories in a directory, excluding hidden and node_modules directories.

methods.name: loadSkillsFromDirSafe
methods.description: Loads skills from a directory, returning the root skill if present or subdirectory skills.

methods.name: readSkillFrontmatterSafe
methods.description: Reads and parses frontmatter from a skill file safely.
